jamal (Eng Manager): Heads up — planning to start parental leave Mon Nov 3. Want to coordinate handover, coverage, and check on paperwork deadlines. Anyone got the current handover template? Also need to switch oncall for 2 weeks.

sophia (People Ops): Congrats! :tada: We have a handover template in the HR drive: https://redwood.internal/hr/parental-handover. Key dates: submit leave request + benefits form at least 30 days before start to guarantee pay top-ups. Payroll cutoff for Nov payroll is 2025-10-20 — submit paperwork ASAP.

rachel (IC): I can take primary oncalls weeks 1-2. jamal, can you DM me the runbook you use for incident triage? Happy to shadow the week before leave.

tony (IC): I can own the weekly sync and async reviews. For handover, include these in the template: 1) active PRs 2) recurring tasks 3) escalation contacts 4) config/local dev gotchas. Small `commands` snippet usually helps:

```
# check pod status
kubectl get pods -n inference
# tail logs
kubectl logs -f svc/inference-api -c model
```

people-ops-bot: Automated checklist: [submit Parental Leave Request] [STD claim if eligible] [Benefits top-up form] [manager sign-off] — visit /leave-requests to start.

jamal (Eng Manager): Thanks — two policy questions: 1) is phased return available (reduced hours) and 2) what's the paid top-up duration? Also any guidance on PTO accrual during leave?

sophia (People Ops): Phased return is supported — up to 12 weeks at reduced hours with manager agreement + approved schedule. We typically ask for a proposed schedule (e.g., 4 days @ 0.6 FTE) and weekly check-ins for 8 weeks. Paid top-up: Redwood adds a company-paid top-up to STD for the first 8 weeks to bring pay to 100% (subject to eligibility). PTO accrual pauses during unpaid leave; if you take paid parental leave through company top-up, accrual continues. I'll DM the exact policy doc and eligibility form.

rachel (IC): FYI — if you plan cross-timezone overlap for the phased return, put timezone in the schedule. We found 10–2pm overlap works well for reviewers.

tony (IC): One more ops note — mark recurring pipeline runs as "on-hold" in the console or hand over a runbook step to avoid cost spikes. I can do this before you go.

jamal (Eng Manager): Awesome. I'll fill the leave request today. Can someone review my handover draft tomorrow? @rachel @tony @sophia

sophia (People Ops): I'll review the leave form and confirm payroll timelines. Tag me when it's submitted. Also we'll schedule an intake call w/people ops + you + your manager 2 weeks before leave to finalize coverage.

rachel (IC): Happy to review tomorrow 10am PT. :+1:

tony (IC): Same — I'll jump on the 10am slot.

jamal (Eng Manager): Thanks all. Appreciate the help :heart:
